<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Detects pulses in a 1-bit input signal data_in. A pulse is defined as a change from 0 to 1 to 0 over three cycles. The output data_out is 1 at the end cycle of the pulse and then returns to 0.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description/>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic"/>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                data_out <= 0;
                // Reset state machine
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            state <= DETECTING_PULSE;
                        end
                    end
                    DETECTING_PULSE: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                            state <= END_OF_PULSE;
                        end
                    end
                    END_OF_PULSE: begin
                        data_out <= 1;
                        if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            state <= DETECTING_PULSE;
                        end else begin
                            state <= IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        // State machine states
        parameter IDLE = 2'b00;
        parameter DETECTING_PULSE = 2'b01;
        parameter END_OF_PULSE = 2'b10;

        // Internal state register
        reg [1:0] state;
    </implementation>
</module>
